create_pipeline_pag_sd_xl_img2img: create a Stable Diffusion XL image-to-image pipeline with perturbed attention guidance for text-to-image generation
run_pipeline_image2image: run the SDXL img2img pipeline with a prompt, init image, and pag_scale to generate a modified image
encode_prompt_text_encoder: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using dual CLIP text encoders with optional clip_skip and lora_scale
prepare_latents_image_noise: prepare initial latents from an input image by encoding through VAE and adding noise at a given timestep
apply_perturbed_attention_guidance: apply perturbed attention guidance to noise predictions using pag_scale and adaptive_scale for improved image quality
